name: Obligation
overview: The Scriptures reveal obligation as a response rooted in the recognition of God's unique and mighty acts on behalf of His people. Deuteronomy emphasizes God's unparalleled intervention, from speaking out of the fire to delivering Israel with great power and love, demonstrating that obedience flows from acknowledging the LORD as the one true God. This acknowledgment compels a motive of obedience, grounded not in compulsion but in gratitude for God's faithful redemption and instruction.
